name: Aarhus
requestSummary: Official Aarhus public cadastral/property viewer was discovered and its anonymous JavaScript/bootstrap configuration was read. It lists queryable municipal and public property themes, including a municipal jordstykker theme, but no parcel feature response, native ID, or geometry was retrieved. The national Matriklen2 WFS requires Bearer authentication. The legacy DAWA coordinate route returned 410.
requests: See city-233-aarhus.json requestsAndEndpointChecks for every executed request and status.
schemaAndCrs: Municipal map metadata center was projected Danish coordinates POINT(570907.820007324 6226395.483999639); source CRS was not asserted because no feature/schema response was obtained. National WFS documentation example uses EPSG:25832 for WFS geometries, but this packet does not treat that as a returned Aarhus feature CRS.
scopeLimits: No exact-point hit or miss interpreted as citywide coverage evidence
No adapter admission or runtime integration
uncertainty: The public viewer may issue further interactive query requests after full client initialization; the observed anonymous config alone is insufficient to qualify an adapter or parcel sample.
completionSummary: Research attempts accurately recorded; packet complete as a held research record, not source integration.
